findings.description: The EBS volume does not set encrypted = true or a KMS key, so data on the attached disk may be stored unencrypted unless account-level defaults happen to enforce encryption.

The user-data script embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key. User data can be retrieved by principals with instance access/metadata access and credentials in IaC must be treated as compromised.
No metadata_options block requires IMDSv2, leaving the instance able to use IMDSv1. An SSRF flaw on the host could then be used to retrieve instance metadata and any attached role credentials.
TCP port 22 is open to 0.0.0.0/0, allowing SSH connection attempts from the entire internet and unnecessarily exposing remote administrative access.
The egress rule permits all protocols and ports to 0.0.0.0/0. This provides an unrestricted path for data exfiltration or command-and-control traffic if the instance is compromised.
The flow-log archive bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so stored network-flow records are not explicitly protected at rest by this configuration.
